description: This file contains automated tests for EventHub slow consumer detection and back pressure logic within an Orleans streaming setup. It defines test classes, fixtures, and test cases using Xunit, focusing on validating back pressure behavior when a slow consumer is present.

classes.name: EHSlowConsumingTests
classes.description: Test suite for evaluating slow consumer detection and back pressure handling in Orleans EventHub streaming.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture setting up the Orleans testing environment and stream provider configuration.

methods.description: Test case verifying that the system favors a slow consumer by triggering back pressure behavior when a slow consumer lags behind.
